assumptions: The CDS given is in frame and translated by the chosen code.
The outermost sites are the deliberate flanks; that is a part-design convention, not a measurement.
limits: Sites outside the CDS are reported, not fixed.
The recoding is graded against SpliceCraft; the site classification and splice-back have no upstream and are checked by contract in the test.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The silent substitutions that clear the internal sites, with the site survey beside them; the Domestication dialog shows the counts and the edits, and the assembly's reading is on golden_gate_assemble.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which silent codon changes remove a part's internal Type-IIS sites without changing its protein?

description: Silently recode the internal Type-IIS sites inside a part's coding sequence so the part can be used in a Golden Gate assembly — same protein, no recognition site. Only occurrences the given CDS covers can be fixed this way; any outside it are reported untouched rather than skipped quietly, because a site in a promoter needs a different answer.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

cds_start.description: 0-based start of the coding sequence within the part.

cds_strand.description: 1 for the top strand, -1 for the bottom. Values: 1 (Top strand), -1 (Bottom strand).

enzyme.description: the Type-IIS enzyme whose sites must go.

sequence.description: the part to domesticate — wire a record, name a library document, or leave unset to use the open record.

table.description: the codon-usage table to guide the synonymous choice, BY NAME, as the Codon Usage panel lists it. This is the way to pass a table: it resolves against the tables loaded in this project, so the numbers come from one someone built or fetched. Leave unset and the active table is used.

table_tsv.description: ONLY for a table you are pasting yourself, measured elsewhere — prefer `table`, which names one this project already has. Do NOT write a table out from memory: codon frequencies are measured data, and a typed one is indistinguishable from a real one in the result. TSV: codon<TAB>count. Advanced.

name: domesticate_part

fixedCount.description: how many internal occurrences were actually fixed

fixes.description: one line per synonymous swap, as the engine logs it

outsideCds.description: internal sites the CDS does NOT cover — left untouched, and yours to solve another way

sequence.description: the part with every reachable internal site recoded
